cold: Three independent new sessions, each apply Git and run public Docker; no cross-session reuse.
cached: Three independent new sessions with same fixed source but different policy and public feedback flags; cold first runs actual Git+public Docker and caches receipt; next two must use identical source cache and avoid Git and public Docker.
cache_scope: same exact source/task/git target/upstream public tests/evaluator code/Docker image; independent prompting histories allowed
hidden: Each independently public-solved session must still run separate hidden Docker tests and preserve original outcomes
measures: Actual Git apply/public Docker counts, full session elapsed wall time, cache hits, independent hidden success, no model calls; order counterbalanced.
cost: No Codex or other external inference; previously generated archival model source reused.
limitations: Only two historically reused upstream issues, each has 3 independent sessions per condition; not a new coding ability or model token savings estimate; timings include Docker warmup and order confounds.
